answer: Every identity must lock a bond before acting, and the protocol slashes that bond when it detects clones sharing one operator. A sybil attacker pays the deposit for each fake persona, so multiplying identities costs linearly while the payoff from one vote does not. Fake identities spread like a dune only when participation is free; a bond turns drifting sand into timber that must be bought and burned. One actor remains an oasis since cloning it is never cheap.
